input.title: Bank of Nova Scotia joins FICC GSD Netting System
input.summary: The Bank of Nova Scotia, New York Agency / BNS Toronto has been added as a new participant in the Netting System of FICC's Government Securities Division, as announced in DTCC notice GOV2284-26.
named_participants: The Bank of Nova Scotia, New York Agency
evidence_quotes: New Participant in the Netting System of the Government Securities Division of FICC: The Bank of Nova Scotia, New York Agency / BNS Toronto – GSD #94IC
input.notes: DTCC official notice confirming a new GSD netting participant. Relevant to FICC-GSD-03 as it reflects ongoing GSD onboarding activity consistent with the Treasury clearing mandate. Reach set to 1 (group/business_line) as this is a single new participant joining, not a market-wide event. Effect date set to announced date as no separate effective date is stated. Content is summary-only.
